name: Chelsea
headline: Who would you rather watch the match with?
subline: Pick your matchday companion. The Blues decide the ranking.

cards.name: Petr Cech
cards.tagline: Never panics, and has the clean sheet record to prove it.

cards.name: Peter Osgood
cards.tagline: King of the Bridge, so he expects the best seat.

cards.name: N'Golo Kante
cards.tagline: Quiet, smiling, and covers every inch of the room.

cards.name: Ashley Cole
cards.tagline: Sharp, serious, and never beaten down the left.

cards.name: Dennis Wise
cards.tagline: Wound up from kick-off and happy to start an argument.

cards.name: Frank Lampard
cards.tagline: Counts every goal, 211 of them, and still wants one more.

cards.name: John Terry
cards.tagline: Captain, leader, legend, and he will organise the whole pub.

cards.name: Didier Drogba
cards.tagline: Silent until the big moment, then he takes over the room.

cards.name: Eden Hazard
cards.tagline: Glides through the game and tells you to relax.

cards.name: Gianfranco Zola
cards.tagline: Smiles at every trick and wants everyone to enjoy the game.

cards.name: Thomas Tuchel
cards.tagline: Intense, detailed, and has a plan for every set piece.

cards.name: Guus Hiddink
cards.tagline: Calm, kind, and the friendliest man in the room.

cards.name: Ruud Gullit
cards.tagline: Cool, stylish, and judges the football with a smile.

cards.name: Claudio Ranieri
cards.tagline: Changes his mind at half-time and makes it sound brilliant.

cards.name: Emma Hayes
cards.tagline: Reads every phase of play and tells you what happens next.

cards.name: Jose Mourinho
cards.tagline: Tells you he is the special one, then proves it.

cards.name: Carlo Ancelotti
cards.tagline: Raised eyebrow, relaxed shrug, and sees everything.

cards.name: Antonio Conte
cards.tagline: Shouts every instruction from the sofa as if he were on the touchline.

cards.name: Roberto Di Matteo
cards.tagline: Quietly confident, and he has already won the big one.

cards.name: Gianluca Vialli
cards.tagline: Warm, stylish, and treats every match as a celebration.

cards.name: Richard Attenborough
cards.tagline: Narrates the match like a classic film, and nobody interrupts.

cards.name: Suggs
cards.tagline: Starts the singing and keeps it going until the final whistle.

cards.name: Sebastian Coe
cards.tagline: Times every run, every substitution, and every final whistle.

cards.name: Michael Caine
cards.tagline: Tells a story from the old days, and it is a good one.

cards.name: Damon Albarn
cards.tagline: Hums the tune of every chant and adds a harmony.

cards.name: Emma Watson
cards.tagline: Quietly knows more than she lets on, then makes a sharp point.

cards.name: Guy Ritchie
cards.tagline: Plots every move like a film and wants a second take.

cards.name: Jeremy Clarkson
cards.tagline: Loud opinions, louder complaints, and a strong view on the referee.

cards.name: Will Ferrell
cards.tagline: Treats every corner like a scene and plays it for laughs.
